a: Ketannae, (detanya): avde chohanim hayu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: mishpachat bet happegarim umishpachat bet tzipperayya, umeemaum hayu, shehayu massiin lakkehunna.
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: leviyyim hayu. may lav beha ka mippalgi, deman deamar avadim hayu, kasavar: ikkar shira bappe. uman deamar leviyyim hayu, kasavar: ikkar shira bichli.
Vetisbera?! rabbi yose may kasavar? i kasavar ikkar shira bappe — afillu avadim name, i kasavar ikkar shira bichli — leviyyim in, yisreelim la!
Ella: dechulle alma ikkar shira bappe. uveha ka mippalgi, demar savar: hachi hava maase, umar savar: hachi hava maase.
Lemay nafka minna? lemaalin midduchan leyuchasin ulemaaser ka mippalgi.

Man deamar avadim hayu, kasavar: en maalin midduchan leyuchasin, velo lemaaser. uman deamar yisrael hayu, kasavar: maalin midduchan yuchasin, aval lo lemaaser. uman deamar leviyyim hayu, kasavar: maalin midduchan, ben leyuchasin ben lemaaser.

Verabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: machloket beshir shel shoeva, derabbi yose bar yehuda savar: simcha yetera name docha et hashshabbat, verabbanan savri: simcha yetera enah docha et hashshabbat. aval beshir shel korban, divre hakkol avoda hi, vedocha et hashshabbat.
Metivi: shir shel shoeva doche et hashshabbat, divre rabbi yose bar yehuda. vachachamim omrim: af yom tov eno doche. teyuveta derav yosef! teyuveta.
Lema beshir shel shoeva hu difligi, aval beshir shel korban divre hakkol doche et hashshabbat. lema tehve teyuveta derav yosef betarte!
Amar lecha rav yosef: peligi beshir shel shoeva, vehu haddin lekorban. vehay dekamippalgi beshir shel shoeva — lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose bar yehuda, daafillu deshoeva name dache.

Veha katane: zehu chalil shel bet hashshoeva sheeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov: zehu deeno doche, aval dekarban doche manni? i nema rabbi yose bar yehuda, haamar shir shel shoeva name doche! ella lav, rabbanan — uteyuveta derav yosef betarte! teyuveta.
May tama deman deamar ikkar shira bichli? dichtiv: "vayyomer chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola lehammizbeach uveet hechel haola hechel shir Adonai vehachatzotzrot veal yede kele david melech yisrael".
May tama deman deamar ikkar shira bappe? dichtiv: "vayhi cheechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim lehashemia kol echad".
Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "vayyomer chizkiyyahu"! hachi kaamar: "hechel shir Adonai" — bappe, "al yede kele david melech yisrael" — levassome kala.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "vayhi keechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim"! hachi kaamar: meshorrim duvmya dimchatztzetzorim, ma mechatztzetzorim — bichli, af meshorrim — bichli.

Mishna mi shello raa simchat bet hashshoeva, lo raa simcha miyyamav. bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag yardu leezrat nashim, umetakkenin sham tikkun gadol. menorot shel zahav hayu sham, vearbaa sefalim shel zahav berashehem, vearbaa sullamot lechol echad veechad, vearbaa yeladim mippirche chehunna uvidehem kaddim shel mea veesrim log shehen metilin lechol sefel vasefel. mibbelae michnese chohanim umehemyaynehen, mehen hayu mafkiin, uvahen hayu madlikin. velo haya chatzer birushalayim sheenah meira meor bet hashshoeva.
Chasidim veanshe maase hayu merakkedin bifnehem
b: Baavukot shel or shebbidehen, veomrim lifnehem divre shirot vetushebachot. vehaleviyyim bechinnorot uvinvalim uvimtziltayim uvachatzotzrot uvichle shir belo mispar, al chamesh esre maalot hayyordot meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, keneged chamesh esre (maalot) shebbattehillim, shealehen leviyyim omdin bichle shir veomrim shira.

Veamdu shene chohanim beshaar haelyon sheyyored meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, ushete chatzotzrot bidehen, kara haggever — taku veheriu vetaku. higgiu lemaala asirit — taku veheriu vetaku. higgiu laazara — taku veheriu vetaku.

(Higgiu lakkarka — taku veheriu vetaku.) hayu tokin veholchin ad shemmaggiin leshaar hayyotze mimmizrach. higgiu leshaar hayyotze mimmizrach — hafchu penehen mimmizrach lemaarav veamru: avotenu shehayu bammakom hazze — "achorehem el hahechol ufenehem kedma umishtachavim kedma lashshemesh", veanu leyah enenu. rabbi yehuda omer, hayu shonin veomrin: anu leyah, uleyah enenu.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mi shello raa simchat bet hashshoeva — lo raa simcha miyyamav. mi shello raa yerushalayim betifartah — lo raa kerach nechmad meolam. mi shello raa bet hammikdash bevinyano — lo raa binyan mefoar meolam. may hi? amar abbaye veittema rav chisda: ze binyan hordos.

Bemay banye? amar (rava): beavne shesha umarmera. ikka deamri: beavne shesha kuchela umarmera. appek safa veayyel safa, ki hechi dilkabbel sida. sevar lemishayeh bedahava, amaru leh rabbanan: shivkeh, dehachi shappir tefe, demitchaze keidvata deyamma.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mi shello raa deyoppeluseton shel alekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, lo raa bichvodan shel yisrael. amru: kemin basilke gedola hayta, setav lefanim missetav. peamim shehayu bah (shishshim ribbo al shishshim ribbo), kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim. vehayu bah shivim veachat katedraot shel zahav, keneged shivim veachat shel sanhedri gedola, kol achat veachat enah pechuta meesrim veechad ribbo kikkere zahav. uvima shel etz beemtzaitah, vechazzan hakkeneset omed aleha vehassudarin beyado. vechevan shehiggia laanot amen, halla menif bassudar vechol haam onin amen.

Velo hayu yoshvin meoravin, ella zehavin bifne atzman vechassafin bifne atzman venappachin bifne atzman vetarsiyyim bifne atzman vegardiyyim bifne atzman. uchesheani nichnas sham, haya makkir baale ummanuto venifne sham. umishsham parnasato ufarnasat anshe veto.
Amar abbaye: vechullehu katlinhu alekkesanderos mokdon. may tama ianush? mishshum deavri ahay kera: "la tosifun lashuv badderech hazze od", veinhu hadur ato.

Ki ata, ashkechinhu dahavo karu besifra: "yissa Adonai alecha goy merachok", amar: mikkede hahu gavra bae lemete sefinta beasra yome, dalya zika veate sefinta bechamsha yome — nefal alayyhu vekatlinhu.
Bemotzae yom tov kulei. may tikkun gadol? amar rabbi elazar: keotah sheshshaninu: chalaka hayta barishona. vehikkifuha gezuzetra, vehitkinu sheyyehu nashim yoshvot milmala vaanashim millematta.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu nashim mibbifnim vaanashim mibbachutz, vehayu baim lide kallut rosh. hitkinu sheyyehu nashim yoshvot mibbachutz vaanashim mibbifnim, vaadayin hayu bain lide kallut rosh. hitkinu sheyyehu nashim yoshvot millemala vaanashim millematta.
Hechi avid hachi? vehachtiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil".
Amar rav: kera ashkachu uderush —

a: "Vesafda haaretz mishpachot mishpachot levad mishpachat bet david levad uneshehem levad". amru: vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma leatid lavo, sheoskin behesped veen yetzer hara sholet bahem — amra tora anashim levad venashim levad. achshav, sheasukin besimcha veyetzer hara sholet bahem — al achat kamma vechamma.
Ha hespeda may avidteh? peligi ba rabbi dosa verabbanan. chad amar: al mashiach ben yosef shenneherag, vechad amar: al yetzer hara shenneherag.

Bishlama leman deamar al mashiach ben yosef shenneherag, hayeynu dichtiv: "vehibbitu elay et asher dakaru vesafdu alav kemisped al hayyachid". ella leman deamar al yetzer hara shenneherag — hay hespeda bae lemebad? simcha bae lemebad! ammay bachu?

Kiddaresh rabbi yehuda: leatid lavo, mevio hakkadosh baruch hu leyetzer hara, veshochato bifne hatztzaddikim uvifne harshaim. tzaddikim nidme lahem kehar gavoah, ureshaim nidme lahem kechut hassaara. hallalu bochin vehallalu bochin. tzaddikim bochin veomrim: heach yacholnu lichbosh har gavoah kaze! ureshaim bochin veomrim: heach lo yacholnu lichbosh et chut hassaara hazze! veaf hakkadosh baruch hu tameah immahem, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai tzevaot ki yippale beene sheerit haam hazze bayyamim hahem gam beenay yippale".
Amar rav assi: yetzer hara battechilla dome lechut shel bucheya, ulevassof dome kaavotot haagala, shenneemar: "hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashshav vechaavot haagala chattaa".

Tanu rabbanan: mashiach ben david sheatid lehiggalot bimhera beyamenu, omer lo hakkadosh baruch hu: sheal mimmenni davar veetten lach, shenneemar: "asappera el chok vegomer ani hayyom yelidticha. sheal mimmenni veettena goyim nachalatecha". vechevan sheraa mashiach ben yosef shenneherag, omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam! eni mevakkesh mimmecha ella chayyim. omer lo: chayyim, ad shello amarta kevar hitnabbe alecha david avicha, shenneemar: "chayyim shaal mimmecha natatta lo vegomer".

Daresh rabbi avvira veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shiva shemot yesh lo leyetzer hara. hakkadosh baruch hu kerao "ra", shenneemar: "ki yetzer lev haadam ra minneurav". moshe kerao "arel", shenneemar: "umaltem et orlat levavchem". david kerao "tame", shenneemar: "lev tahor bera li elohim", mikkelal deikka tame.

Shelomo kerao "sone", shenneemar: "im raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim tzame hashekehu mayim ki gechalim atta chote al rosho vaAdonai yeshallem lach". al tikre "yeshallem lach", ella "yashlimennu lach".

Yeshaya kerao "michshol", shenneemar: "sollu sollu pannu darech harimu michshol midderech ammi". yechezkel kerao "even", shenneemar: "vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar". yoel kerao "tzefoni", shenneemar: "veet hatztzefoni archik mealechem". tanu rabbanan: "veet hatztzefoni archik mealechem" — ze yetzer hara, shetztzafun veomed belibbo shel adam.

"Vehiddachtiv el eretz tziyya ushemama" — limkom sheen bene adam metzuyin lehitgarot bahen. "et panav el hayyam hakkadmoni" — shennatan enav bemikdash rishon vehechrivo, veharag talmide chachamim shebbo. "vesofo el hayyam haacharon" — shennatan enav bemikdash sheni vehechrivo, veharag talmide chachamim shebbo. "veala vosho vetaal tzachanato" — shemmanniach ummot haolam, umitgare besonehem shel yisrael. "ki higdil laasot" — amar abbaye: uvetalmide chachamim yoter mikkullam.

Ki ha deabbaye shameh lehahu gavra dekaamar lehahi itteta: nakdem venezil beorcha. amar: ezil afreshinhu meissura. azal batrayyhu telata parse beagma. ki havo parshi mehadade, shaminhu deka amri: orchin rachika, vetzavvtin besima.
Amar abbaye: i man desane li hava, la hava matze leokome nafsheh. azal tela nafsheh beibbura dedasha umitztaer. ata hahu sava, tena leh: kol haggadol mechavero — yitzro gadol hemennu.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: yitzro shel adam mitgabber alav bechol yom, shenneemar: "rak
b: Ra kol hayyom". amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: yitzro shel adam mitgabber alav bechol yom umevakkesh lahamito, shenneemar: "tzofe rasha latztzaddik umevakkesh lahamito", veilmale hakkadosh baruch hu sheozer lo — eno yachol lo, shenneemar: "Adonai lo yaazvennu veyado velo yarshiennu behishshafto".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: im paga becha menuuol ze — moshchehu levet hammidrash. im even hu — nimmoach, im barzel hu mitpotzetz. im even hu nimmoach, dichtiv: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim", uchetiv: "avanim shachaku mayim". im barzel hu mitpotzetz, dichtiv: "hal cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchefattish yefotzetz sala".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: yetzer hara mesito laadam baolam hazze, umeid alav laolam habba, shenneemar: "mefannek minnoar avdo veacharito yihye manon" — shekken beatba"8 shel rabbi chiyyay, korin lesahada manon.
Rav huna rame ketiv: "ki ruach zenunim hita". uchetiv: "bekirbam"! battechilla hitam, ulevassof bekirbam.

Amar rava: battechilla kerao "helech", ulevassof kerao "oreach", ulevassof kerao "ish", shenneemar: "vayyavo helech leish heashir vayyachmol lakachat mitztzono umibbekaro laasot laoreach", uchetiv: "vayyikkach et kivsat haish harash vayyaaseha laish habba elav".
Amar rabbi yochanan: ever katan yesh lo laadam, marivo — savea, masbio — raev, shenneemar: "kemaritam vayyisbau vegomer".

Amar rav chana bar acha, amri be rav: arbaa mitcharet alehen hakkadosh baruch hu shebberaam, veellu hen: galut, kasdim, veyishmeelim, veyetzer hara. galut, dichtiv: "veatta ma li fo neum Adonai ki lukkach ammi chinnam vegomer". kasdim, dichtiv: "hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya".
Yishmeelim, dichtiv: "yishlayu ohalim leshoddim uvattuchot lemargize el laasher hevi eloah beyado". yetzer hara, dichtiv: "vaasher hareoti".

Amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale shalosh mikraot hallalu, nitmottu raglehem shel sonehen shel yisrael. chad, dichtiv: "vaasher hareoti". vechad, dichtiv: "hinne chachomer beyad hayyotzer ken attem vegomer". veiddach: "vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar".
Rav pappa amar, af mehay name: "veet ruchi etten bekirbechem vegomer".

"Vayyareni Adonai arbaa charashim", man ninhu arbaa charashim? amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: mashiach ben david, umashiach ben yosef, veeliyyahu, vechohen tzedek. metiv rav sheshet: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyomer elay elle hakkeranot asher zeru et yehuda", hane leshuva atu!
Amar leh, shefel lesefeh dikra: "veyavou elle lehacharid otam leyaddot et karnot haggoyim hannosim keren el eretz yehuda lezarotah vegomer". amar leh: bahade chana beaggadta lema li.

"Vehaya ze shalom ashshur ki yavo veartzenu vechi yidroch bearmenotenu vahakemonu alav shiva roim ushemona nesiche adam". man ninhu "shiva roim"? david baemtza, adam shet umetushelach mimino, avraham yaakov umoshe bismolo. uman ninhu "shemona nesiche adam"? yishay, veshaul, ushemuel, amos, utzefanya, tzidkiyya, umashiach, veeliyyahu.

Arbaa sullamot kulei. tana: govhah shel menora chamishshim amma, vearbaa yeladim shel pirche kehunna, uvidehem kadde shemen shel mea veesrim log. ibbaya lehu: mea veesrim log kullehu, o dilma lechol chad vechad? ta shema: uvidehem kadde shemen shel sheloshim sheloshim log, shehem kullam mea veesrim log.

Tana: vehen meshubbachin hayu yoter mibbenah shel marta bat bayytos. amru al benah shel marta bat bayytos shehaya notel shete yerechot shel shor haggadol shellakuach beelef zuz, umehallech akev betzad gudal. velo henichuhu echav hakkohanim laasot ken, mishshum: "berov am haderat melech".
May meshubbachim? illema mishshum yukera — hane yakkiri tefe! ella: hatam kevesh, umerubba, vela zekif. hacha sullamot, uzekif tuva.
Velo haya chatzer birushalayim. tana:

a: Ishsha hayta boreret chittim laor shel bet hashshoeva.

Chasidim veanshe maase kulei. tanu rabbanan, yesh mehen omrim: ashre yaldutenu shello biyyeysha et ziknutenu — ellu chasidim veanshe maase. veyesh mehen omrim: ashre ziknutenu shekkippera et yaldutenu — ellu baale teshuva. ellu vaellu omrim: ashre mi shello chata, umi shechata — yashuv veyimchol lo.

Tanya: amru alav al hillel hazzaken, keshehaya sameach besimchat bet hashshoeva, amar ken: im ani kan — hakkol kan, veim eni kan — mi kan. hu haya omer ken: makom sheani ohev — sham raglay molichot oti. im tavo el beti — ani avo el betecha, im atta lo tavo el beti — ani lo avo el betecha, shenneemar: "bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha".

Af hu raa gulgolet achat shetztzafa al pene hammayim, amar la: al deatteft atfuch umetifayich yetufun. amar rabbi yochanan: raglohi devar inish innun arvin beh, laatar demitbee — tamman movilin yateh.

Hanhu tarte kushae dahavo kayymi kamme shelomo, elichoref vaachiyya bene shisha, sofrim dishlomo havo. yoma chad chazyeh malach hammavet dahava ka atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: deka vau minnay hane tarte kushae deyatvi hacha. masrinhu lisirim, shadderinhu lemachoza deluz. ki meto lemachoza deluz — shechivu.

Limchar, chazye malach hammavet dahava kavadach! amar leh: ammay bedichat? amar leh: baatar divo minnay, tamman shaddartinhu. miyyad patach shelomo veamar: raglohi devar inish innun arvin beh, laatar demitbee — tamman movilin yateh.

Tanya: amru alav al rabban shimon ben gamliel, keshehaya sameach simchat bet hashshoeva, haya notel shemone avukot shel or, vezorek achat venotel achat veen nogot zo bazo. ucheshehu mishtachave, noetz shene gudalav baaretz veshoche venoshek et haritzpa vezokef, veen kol beriyya yechola laasot ken, vezo hi kidda.

Levi achvi kidda kammeh derabbi veittela. veha gerama leh? vehaamar rabbi elazar: leolam al yatiach adam devarim kelappe mala, shehare adam gadol hetiach devarim kelappe mala veittela, umannu — levi. ha veha gerama leh.
Levi hava metayyel kammeh derabbi betamne sakkine. shemuel kammeh shabbur malka bitmanya mezage chamra. abbaye kammeh (derava) bitmanya bee, veamri la bearbea bee.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: keshehayinu semechim simchat bet hashshoeva, lo rainu shena beenenu. ketzad? shaa rishona tamid shel shachar, mishsham litfilla, mishsham lekorban musaf, mishsham litfillat hammusafin, mishsham levet hammidrash, mishsham laachila ushetiyya, mishsham litfillat hammincha, mishsham letamid shel ben haarbayim, mikkan veelach lesimchat bet hashshoeva.
Ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: "shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim" — malkin oto veyashen lealtar! ella hachi kaamar: lo taamnu taam shena, dahavo menamnemi akkatpa dahadade.

Chamesh esre maalot. amar leh rav chisda lehahu midderabbanan dahava kamsaddar aggadata kammeh, amar leh: shemia lecha, hane chamesh esre maalot, keneged mi amaram david? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shekkara david shitin, kefa tehoma uvae lemishtefeh lealma. amar david chamesh esre maalot vehoridan. i hachi, chamesh esre "maalot" — "yordot" mibbee leh!
Amar leh: hoil veadkartan (milleta), hachi ittemar: beshaa shekkara david shitin, kefa tehoma uvea lemishtefeh lealma. amar david: mi ikka deyada i shere lemichtav shem
b: Achaspa, venishdeye bithoma umannach! lekka dekaamar leh midde. amar david: kol deyada lememar veeno omer, yechanek bigrono. nasa achitofel kal vachomer beatzmo: uma laasot shalom ben ish leishto, amra tora: shemi shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim, laasot shalom lechol haolam kullo — al achat kamma vechamma. amar leh: shere.

Katev shem achaspa veshade lithoma, unechet tehoma shittesar alfe garmide. ki chaze denachet tuva, amar: kamma demiddele — tefe mirtav alma. amar chamesh esre maalot, veassekeh chamesar alfe garmide, veokmeh bealpa garmide. amar ulla: shema minna sumecha deara alpa garmide. veha chazenan decharenan pureta venafki mayya! amar rav mesharsheya: hahu missullama difrat.
Veamdu kohanim beshaar haelyon sheyyored kulei. bae rabbi yirmeya: lemaala asirit — denachet chamsha vekae aasra, o dilma denachet asra vekae achamsha? teku.
Tanu rabbanan, mimmashma shenneemar: "ufenehem kedma", eni yodea sheachorehem el hechal Adonai"?
Ella ma talmud lomar: "achorehem el hechal Adonai" — melammed shehayu porin atzman, umatrizin kelappe matta.

Anu leyah uleyah enenu kulei. ini?! vehaamar rabbi zera: kol haomer "shema" "shema", keillu amar "modim" "modim"! ella hachi amri: hemma mishtachavim kedma, veanu leyah (anachnu modim), veenenu leyah meyachalot.

Mishna en pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, veen mosifin al arbaim ushemone. bechol yom hayu sham esrim veachat tekiot bammikdash: shalosh liftichat shearim, vetesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim. uvammusafin hayu mosifin od tesha.
Uveerev shabbat hayu mosifin shesh: shalosh lehavetil et haam mimmelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol.

Erev shabbat shebbetoch hachag hayu sham arbaim ushemone: shalosh liftichat shearim, shalosh leshaar haelyon, veshalosh leshaar hattachton, veshalosh lemilluy hammayim, veshalosh al gabbe mizbeach, tesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim, vetesha lemusafin, shalosh lehavetil et haam min hammelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol.

Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: happochet lo yifchot mishsheva, vehammosif lo yosif al shesh esre. bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi yehuda savar: tekia terua tekia — achat hi, verabbanan savri: tekia lechud uterua lechud.

May tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "utekatem terua" (uchetiv: "terua yitkeu", ha ketzad? tekia uterua — achat hi). verabbanan: hahu lifshuta lefaneha uleachareha hu daata (verabbi yehuda, lefaneha uleachareha menaleh? nafka leh mishshenit").

Verabbanan, may tamayyhu? dichtiv: "uvehakhil et hakkahal titkeu velo tariu", vei salka datach: tekia terua — achat hi, amar rachamana palga demitzva aved ufalga la aved?! verabbi yehuda: hahu lesimana bealma hu daata.
Verabbanan: simana hu, verachamana shavveye mitzva. keman azla ha deamar rav kahana: en ben tekia litrua velo kelum, keman? kerabbi yehuda. (i rabbi yehuda) peshita!

a: Mahu detema: afillu kerabbanan, uleappoke midderabbi yochanan deamar: shama tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom — yatza, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! im ken, may "velo kelum"?

Erev shabbat shebbetoch hachag kulei. veillu lemaala asirit la katane. matnitin manni? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. detanya: shalosh lemaala asirit, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: shalosh al gabbe hammizbeach.
Haomer lemaala asirit — eno omer al gabbe hammizbeach, vehaomer al gabbe hammizbeach — eno omer lemaala asirit.

May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov? kevan detaka liftichat shearim, lemaala asirit lema li detaka? hay lav shaar hu! hilkach, al gabbe hammizbeach adif. verabbanan savri: kevan detaka lemilluy hammayim, al gabbe hammizbeach lema li? hilkach, lemaala haasirit adif.

Ki ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma, ayyti matnita bideh: "uvene aharon hakkohanim yitkeu bachatzotzrot", sheen talmud lomar "yitkeu", shekkevar neemar "utekatem bachatzotzrot al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem". uma talmud lomar "yitkeu" — hakkol lefi hammusafin tokin. hu tane la, vehu amar la: lomar shettokin al kol musaf umusaf.

Tenan: erev shabbat shebbetoch hachag hayu sham arbaim ushemone. veim ita, litne: shabbat shebbetoch hachag mashkachat la chamshin vechad! amar rabbi zera: lefi sheen tokin liftichat shearim beshabbat.

Amar rava: man hay dela chash lekimcheh! chada: divchol yom" tenan, veod: i name kahadade ninhu, litne shabbat shebbetoch hachag hayu sham arbaim ushemone, deshamat minna tarte: shamat minna derabbi eliezer ben yaakov, veshamat minna derabbi acha bar chanina.

Ella amar rava: lefi sheen tokin lemilluy mayim beshabbat, devatzri tuva. velitne name rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat, deha ikka telata musafin: musaf derosh hashshana, musaf derosh chodesh, musaf deshabbat.
Erev shabbat shebbetoch hachag itzterich leh, leashmoinan kidrabbi eliezer ben yaakov. attu mi kaamar — litne ha vela litne ha? litne ha velitne ha! tena veshayyayr. may shayyer dehay shayyayr?
Shayyayr erev happesach.
b: I mishshum erev happesach — lav shiyyura hu, deha manni rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: mimehem shel kat shelishit lo higgia lomar "ahavti ki yishma Adonai", mippene shehayu ammah muatin.
(Ha okemna) dela kerabbi yehuda! vedilma hay tanna savar la kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Ella: may shayyayr dehay shayyayr? shayyayr erev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, appek shet veayyel shet.
Veen mosifin al arbaim ushemone. vela? veha ikka erev happesach shechal lihyot beshabbat, dei lerabbi yehuda — chamshin vachada, i lerabbanan — chamshin usheva!

Ki katane, midde deiteh bechol shana. erev happesach shechal lihyot beshabbat, deleteh bechol shana veshana, la katane. attu erev shabbat shebbetoch hachag mi iteh bechol shana? zimnin dela mashkachat leh. vehechi dame, kegon shechal yom tov rishon beerev shabbat.

Ki mikkela yom tov rishon beerev shabbat — midche dachenan leh. may tama, kevan deikkela yom tov harishon shel chag lihyot beerev shabbat, yom hakkippurim emat have — bechad beshabbat, hilkach dachenan leh.
Umi dachenan leh? veha tenan: chelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim,

Veamar rabbi zera: ki havenan be rav bevavel, hava amri ha detanya: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot erev shabbat lo hayu tokin, uvemotzae shabbat lo hayu mavdilin — divre hakkol hi. ki selekit lehatam, ashkachteh lerabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi, deyatev vekaamar: rabbi akiva hi!
La kashya: ha rabbanan, ha acherim hi.
Detanya, acherim omrim: en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad, veim hayta shana meubberet — chamishsha.
Metivi: rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat — shir shel rosh chodesh doche shir shel shabbat. vei ita, lema deshabbat velema derosh chodesh!
Amar rav safra: may doche — doche likkadem. veammay? tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem!

Amar rabbi yochanan: leda shehukeba rosh chodesh bizmanno. vehay hekkera avdinan? ha hekkera acharina avdinan! (detanya) chelve tamid shel shachar nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulematta bammizrach, veshel musafin nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulematta bammaarav, veshel rosh chodesh nittanin tachat karkov hammizbeach ulematta.

a: Veamar rabbi yochanan: leda shehukeba rosh chodesh bizmanno. tere hekkera avdinan. dechaze hay — chaze, vechaze behay — chaze.

Metivi, detane rava bar shemuel: yachol keshem shettokin al shabbat bifne atzmo veal rosh chodesh bifne atzmo, kach yihyu tokin al kol musaf umusaf — talmud lomar: "uverashe chodshechem", teyuveta derabbi acha! teyuveta.

May talmuda? amar abbaye, amar kera: "uverashe chodshechem" — hukkeshu kol chodashim kullam ze laze. rav ashe amar: ketiv "chodshechem", uchetiv "uverashe" — veeze chodesh sheyyesh lo shene rashim, heve omer: ze rosh hashshana, veamar rachamana "chodshechem", chad hi.
Veod, tanya: bechullo shel moed, barishon me hayu omrim: "havu laAdonai bene elim". bashsheni me hayu omrim: "velarasha amar elohim". bashshelishi me hayu omrim: "mi yakum li im mereim".

Barvii me hayu omrim: "binu boarim baam". bachamishi me hayu omrim: "hasiroti missevel shichmo". bashshishshi me hayu omrim: "yimmotu kol mosde aretz". veim chal shabbat beechad mehem, "yimmotu" yiddache.
Rav safra mannach behu simana: "humebahe"10". rav pappa mannach behu simana: "humehabbe"10". vesimanach, "ambuha desafre".
Teyuveta derabbi acha bar chanina! teyuveta. veha rabbi acha bar chanina kera umatnita kaamar?
Amar ravina: lomar shemmaarichin bitkiot. rabbanan dekesari mishshemeh derabbi acha amri: lomar shemmarbe betokin.
Vaanan, deit lan tere yome, hechi avdinan? abbaye amar: sheni yiddache.
Rava amar: shevii yiddache. tanya kevateh derava: im chal shabbat lihyot beechad mehen, "yimmotu" yiddache.
Atkin ammemar binhardea, dimdallegi dalloge.
b: Mishna yom tov harishon shel chag hayu sham shelosha asar parim, elim shenayim vesair echad. nishtayyeyru sham arbaa asar kevasim lishmone mishmarot. beyom rishon, shishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad.
Bashsheni, chamishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad. bashshelishi, arbaa makrivin shenayim shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad.

Barvii, shelosha makrivin shenayim shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad. bachamishi, shenayim makrivin shenayim shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad. bashshishshi, echad makriv shenayim. vehashshear, echad echad.
Bashshevii, kullan shavin. bashshemini, chazru lappayis kevargalim. amru: mi shehikriv parim hayyom — lo yakriv lemachar, ella chozrin chalila.
Gemara nema matnitin rabbi hi vela rabbanan? detanya: par habba bashshemini — battechilla mefayyesin alav, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: achat mishte mishmarot delo shilleshu befarim, osa oto.
Afillu tema rabbanan, attu shete mishmarot la appose bae?

Keman azla ha detanya: kol hammishmarot shonot umeshalleshot, chutz mishshene mishmarot sheshshonot veen meshalleshot? nema rabbi vela rabbanan! afillu tema rabbanan: may lo shilleshu — befare hachag.
Umay ka mashma lan! ha ka mashma lan: mi shehikriv parim hayyom — lo yakriv lemachar, ella chozrin chalila.
Amar rabbi (elazar): hane shivim parim keneged mi — keneged shivim ummot. par yechidi lamma — keneged umma yechida.
Mashal lemelech basar vadam sheamar laavadav: asu li seuda gedola. leyom acharon amar leohavo: ase li seuda ketanna kede sheehane mimmecha.
Amar rabbi yochanan: oy lahem laggoyim, sheibbedu — veen yodin ma sheibbedu. bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, mizbeach mechapper alehen. veachshav, mi mechapper alehen?!
Mishna bishlosha perakim bashshana hayu kol mishmarot shavot: beemure hargalim, uvechilluk lechem happanim.
Baatzeret, omer lo: helach matztza, helach chametz. mishmar shezzemanno kavua, hu makriv temidin, nedarim unedavot, ushear korbenot tzibbur — umakriv et hakkol.
Gemara emure hargalim shel gavoah ninhu! amar rav chisda: ma sheamur bargalim.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin shekkol hammishmarot shavot beemure hargalim, talmud lomar: "uva bechol avvat nafsho ... vesheret". yachol af bishar yemot hashshana ken — talmud lomar: "meachad shearecha", lo amarti ella beshaa shekkol yisrael nichnasin beshaar echad.
Uvechilluk lechem happanim kulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin shekkol hammishmarot shavot bechilluk lechem happanim —

a: Talmud lomar: "chelek kechelek yochelu", kechelek avoda kach chelek achila. umay achila? illema korbanot, mehatam nafka: "lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye"! ella: lechem happanim.
Yachol af bechovot habbaot shello mechamat haregel baregel, talmud lomar: "levad mimkarav al haavot" — ma machru haavot ze laze, ani beshabbatti veatta beshabbattecha.
Baatzeret omer lo helach vechulei. ittemar, rav amar: sukka, veachar kach zeman. rabba bar bar chana amar: zeman, veachar kach sukka.
Rav amar: sukka veachar kach zeman — chiyyuva deyoma adif. rabba bar bar chana amar: zeman veachar kach sukka — tadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem.

Lema rav verabba bar bar chana biflugeta devet shammay uvet hillel kamippalgi, detanu rabbanan: devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel basseuda. bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin, uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom.

Bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin — shehayyom gorem layyayin sheyyavo, uchevar kiddesh hayyom vaadayin yayin lo ba. uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom — shehayyayin gorem lekiddusha shetteamer. davar acher: birkat hayyayin tedira, uvirkat hayyom enah tedira. tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem.
Lema rav deamar kevet shammay, verabba bar bar chana deamar kevet hillel!
Amar lecha rav: ana daamari afillu levet hillel. ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hatam, ella shehayyayin gorem lekiddusha shetteamer; aval hacha — i lav zeman, mi la amrinan sukka!
Verabba bar bar chana amar lach: ana daamari afillu levet shammay. ad kan la amri bet shammay hatam, ella shehayyom gorem layyayin sheyyavo; aval hacha — i lav sukka, mi la amrinan zeman!
Tenan, baatzeret omer lo: helach matztza, helach chametz. veha hacha, dechametz ikkar umatztza tafel, vekatane: helach matztza vehelach chametz, teyuveta derav!
Amar lecha rav: tannae hi. detanya: helach matztza, helach chametz. abba shaul omer: helach chametz, helach matztza.

Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: lo kedivre rav, deamar: sukka, veachar kach zeman — ella: zeman, veachar kach sukka. verav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: sukka, veachar kach zeman. vehilcheta: sukka, veachar kach zeman.
Mishmar shezzemanno kavua [vechulei], ushear korbenot tzibbur. leetoye may? leetoye par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara.
Vehu makriv et hakkol. leetoye may? leetoye keytz hammizbeach.

Mishna yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat, ben millefaneha ben leachareha — hayu kol hammishmarot shavot bechilluk lechem happanim. chal lihyot yom echad [lehafesik] benatayim — mishmar shezzemanno kavua haya notel eser challot, vehammitakkev notel shetayim. uvishar yemot hashshana — hannichnas notel shesh, vehayyotze notel shesh. rabbi yehuda omer: hannichnas notel sheva, vehayyotze notel chamesh.
Hannichnasin cholkin batztzafon, vehayyotzin baddarom. bilga leolam choleket baddarom, vetabbatah kevua, vechallonah setuma.
Gemara may millefaneha umay milleachareha? ilema: lefaneha — yom tov rishon, leachareha — yom tov acharon, hayeynu shabbat shebbetoch hechag.
Ella: lefaneha — yom tov acharon. leachareha — yom tov rishon. may tama — kevan dehane mekaddemi vehane meachari, takkinu rabbanan milleta ki hechi denechlu bahade hadade.
Chal yom echad.
b: Vehane tarte may avidtayyhu? amar rabbi yitzchak: bischar haggafat delatot. venema leh dal bedal! amar abbaye: butzina tava mikkara.

Amar rav yehuda: uvammusafin cholkin. metivi: mishmara hayyotzet osa tamid shel shachar umusafin, mishmara hannichneset osa tamid shel ben haarbayim uvazichin — veillu "musafin cholkin" la katane! hay tanna bachalukka la ka mayyre.

Amar rava: veha tana deve shemuel, demayyri bachalukka, uvammusafin cholkin" la katane? detana deve shemuel: mishmara hayyotzet osa tamid shel shachar umusafin, mishmara hannichneset osa tamid shel ben haarbayim uvazichin. arbaa kohanim hayu nichnasin sham. shenayim mimmishmara zo, ushenayim mimmishmara zo, vecholkin lechem happanim. veillu "bammusafin cholkin" la katane! teyuveta derav yehuda! teyuveta.
Hannichnasin cholkin batztzafon. tanu rabbanan: hannichnasin cholkin batztzafon — kede sheyyerau shehen nichnasin, vehayyotzin cholkin baddarom — kede sheyyerau shehen yotzin.

Bilga leolam choleket baddarom. tanu rabbanan: maase bemiryam bat bilga shehemira datah, vehalcha venisset lesardeyot echad mimmalche yevonim. keshennichnesu yevonim lahechol, hayta mevaetet besandalah al gabbe hammizbeach, veamra: lokus lokus! ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael vei atta omed alehem bishat haddechak! uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, kavu et tabbatah vesatmu et challonah.

Veyesh omrim: mishmarto shoha lavo, venichnas yeshevav achiv immo veshimmesh tachtav. af al pi sheshshechene harshaim lo nistakkeru, shechene vilga — nistakkeru, shebbilga leolam choleket baddarom, veyeshevav achiv batztzafon.

Bishlama leman deamar mishmarto shoha lavo, hayeynu dekansinan lechulla mishmara. ella leman deamar miryam bat bilga shehemira data, mishshum beratte kansinan leh ledideh? amar abbaye: in, kidamri inashe: shuta deyanoka beshuka, o daavuah o deimmeh.
Umishshum avu veimmeh kansinan lechulla mishmara? amar abbaye: oy larasha oy lishcheno, tov latztzaddik tov lishcheno [shenneemar: "imru tzaddik ki tov ki feri maallehem yochelu"].
Hadaran alach hechalil uselika la massechet sukka

a: Betza shennolda beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: teachel, uvet hillel omrim: lo teachel. bet shammay omrim: seor bechazzayit vechametz bechakkotevet, uvet hillel omrim: ze veze bechazzayit.

Hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: yachpor baddakar vichasse, uvet hillel omrim: lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom. umodim sheim shachat, sheyyachpor baddakar vichasse — sheefer kira muchan hu.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema betarnegolet haomedet laachila, may tamayyhu devet hillel? uchela deipperat hu!
Ella, betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim.
May tamayyhu devet shammay? muketze hi! umay kusheya? dilma bet shammay let lehu muketze!
Ka salka datin: afillu man deshare bemuketze, benolad asar. may tamayyhu devet shammay?
Amar rav nachman: leolam betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim, udeit leh muketze — it leh nolad, udelet leh muketze — let leh nolad. bet shammay kerabbi shimon, uvet hillel kerabbi yehuda.
Umi amar rav nachman hachi? vehatnan: bet shammay omrim: magbihin meal hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin, uvet hillel omrim: mesallek et hattavla kullah umenaarah.
Veamar rav nachman: anu en lanu ella bet shammay kerabbi yehuda, uvet hillel kerabbi shimon!
Amar lecha rav nachman: gabbe shabbat, distam lan tena kerabbi shimon, ditnan: mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim —
Mokem lah levet hillel kerabbi shimon. aval
b: Gabbe yom tov, distam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda, ditnan: en mevakkein etzim min hakkorot velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov — mokem lah levet hillel kerabbi yehuda.
Mikkede, man satmay lematnitin — rabbi. may shena beshabbat distam lan kerabbi shimon, umay shena beyom tov distam lan kerabbi yehuda?
Amri: shabbat dachamira, vela ate lezalzole ba — satem lan kerabbi shimon demekel, yom tov dekil, veate lezalzole beh — satem lan kerabbi yehuda demachmir.
Bemay okemta — betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim, umishshum muketze. i hachi, addemippalgi bevetza, lippalgu betarnegolet?
Lehodiacha kochan devet shammay, divnolad shere.
Veliflugoy betarnegolet, lehodiacha kochan devet hillel, divmuketze asri! vechi tema koach dehettera adif — veniflog betarvayyhu:
Tarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim, hi uvetzatah, bet shammay omrim: teachel, uvet hillel omrim: lo teachel.
Ella, amar rabba: leolam betarnegolet haomedet laachila, uveyom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat askinan, umishshum hachana.
Vekasavar rabba, kol betza demityalda haiddana — meetmol gamra lah.

Verabba letameh. deamar rabba, may dichtiv: "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu et asher yaviu" — chol mechin leshabbat, vechol mechin leyom tov, veen yom tov mechin leshabbat, veen shabbat mechina leyom tov.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, yom tov bealma tishtere! gezera mishshum yom tov achar hashshabbat. shabbat dealma tishtere! gezera mishshum shabbat achar yom tov.
Umi gazrinan? veha tanya: hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot — muttarot leachlan beyom tov. veim ita — ligzar mishshum hanach demityalledan beyomehen!
Amar leh: betzim gemurot bime imman — milleta dela shechicha hi, umilleta dela shechicha la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Rav yosef amar: gezera mishshum perot hannoshrin.
Amar leh abbaye: perot hannoshrin tama may —

a: Gezera shemma yaale veyitlosh. hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera? kullah chada gezera hi.
Rabbi yitzchak amar: gezera mishshum mashkin shezzavu.
Amar leh abbaye: mashkin shezzavu tama may — gezera shemma yischot, hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera? kulla chada gezera hi.
Kullehu kerav nachman la amri — ki kusheyayn. kerabba name la amri — hachana let lehu.
Ella rav yosef may tama la amar kerabbi yitzchak? amar lach: betza uchela, uferot uchela. leappoke mashkin — delav uchela.
Verabbi yitzchak may tama la amar kerav yosef? amar lach: betza belua, umashkin beluin. leappoke perot — demiggallu vekayymu.
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar gezera mishshum mashkin shezzavu. derabbi yochanan rame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, umeshanne.
Tenan: en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin, veim yatzu meatzman — asurin. rabbi yehuda omer: im laochalin — hayyotze mehen muttar, veim lemashkin — hayyotze mehen asur.
Alma kol ochalin lerabbi yehuda — uchela deipperat hu.
Ureminhu, veod amar rabbi yehuda: matne adam al kalkala shel perot beyom tov rishon,
Veochlah bashsheni. vechen betza shennolda barishon, teachel bashsheni.
Bashsheni in, barishon la! umeshanne rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.
Umiddeka marme lehu ahadade, shema minna chad tama hu.
b: Ravina amar: leolam la tefoch, verabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu:
Ledidi afillu barishon name sharya, deuchela deipperat hu. ella ledidchu — odo li mihat devashsheni sharya, dishte kedushshot hen. veamri leh rabbanan: la, kedushsha achat hi.
Ravina bereh derav ulla amar: hacha betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim, verabbi yehuda letameh, deit leh muketze.
Metivi: echad betza shennolda beshabbat veechad betza shennolda beyom tov — en metaltelin otah, lo lechassot bah et hakkeli, velo lismoch bah kare hammitta.
Aval kofe aleha et hakkeli bishvil shello tishshaver. usefeka asura, veim nitarva beelef — kullan asurot.
Bishlama lerabba, deamar mishshum hachana, have sefeka deorayyta — vechol sefeka deorayyta lechumera.
Ella lerav yosef ulerabbi yitzchak, deamri mishshum gezera, sefeka derabbanan hi — vechol sefeka derabbanan lekulla!
(Amar leh:) sefa atan lisfek terefa.
I hachi, ema sefa: nitarva beelef — kullan asurot. i amrat bishlama safek yom tov safek chol, have davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin — afillu beelef lo batel.
Ella i amrat sefek terefa, davar sheen lo mattirin hi, vetivtal berubba!
Vechi tema betza chashuva velo batla, hanicha leman deamar: kol sheddarko limmanot shaninu.
Ella leman deamar: et sheddarko limmanot shaninu, may ikka lememar!
Ditnan: mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem — yidleku. nitarvu baacherot, vaacherot baacherot — kullan yiddalku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yaalu beachat umatayim.

Shehaya rabbi meir omer: et sheddarko limmanot — mekaddesh; vachachamim omrim: eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad; rabbi akiva omer: shiva. veellu hen: egoze perech, verimmone badan, vechaviyyot setumot, vechilfe teradin, vekilche cheruv, vedallaat yevanit. rabbi akiva mosif af kikkarot shel baal habbayit.
Harauy leorla — orla. harauy lechile hakkerem — kile hakkerem. veittemar ala, rabbi yochanan amar: et sheddarko limmanot shaninu. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: kol sheddarko limmanot shaninu.
Hanicha lerabbi shimon ben lakish, ella lerabbi yochanan — may ikka lememar?
Amar rav pappa: hay tanna — tanna delitra ketziot hu, deamar: kol davar shebbeminyan, afillu bidrabbanan lo batel, vechol shekken bidorayyta.

Ditnan: litra ketziot shedderasah al pi iggul, veeno yodea beeze iggul derasah, al pi chavit, veeno yodea beezo chavit derasah, al pi kavveret, veeno yodea beezo kavveret derasah. rabbi meir omer, rabbi eliezer

a: Omer: roin et haelyonot kaellu hen perudot, vehattachtonot maalot et haelyonot.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: im yesh sham mea pummin — yaalu, veim lav — happummin asurin, vehashshulayim muttarin.
Rabbi yehuda omer, rabbi eliezer omer: im yesh sham mea pummin — yaalu, veim lav — happummin asurin, vehashshulayim muttarin. rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu yesh sham shelosh meot pummin — lo yaalu.
Derasah beiggul veeno yodea beeze iggul derasah — divre hakkol yaalu. divre hakkol?! hayeynu pelugetayyhu!
Amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: derasah beiggul, veeno yodea beeze mekom iggul derasah, i litzfonah i lidromah — divre hakkol yaalu.
Rav ashe amar: leolam safek yom tov safek chol have davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin — afillu bidrabbanan lo batel.

Tanya, acherim omrim mishshum rabbi eliezer: betza — teachel hi veimmah. bemay askinan? ilema betarnegolet haomedet laachila — peshita dehi veimmah sharya! ella betarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim — hi veimmah asura! amar rabbi zera: teachel aggav immah.
Hechi dame? amar abbaye: kegon shellekachah setam, nishchata — huverra delaachila omedet. lo nishchata — huverra dilgaddel betzim omedet.
Rav mari amar: guzema katane. detanya, acherim omrim mishshum rabbi eliezer: betza teachel hi veimmah, veefroach ukelippato.

May kelippato? illema kelippa mammash, kelippa bat achila hi? ella efroach biklippato. ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ella hecha deyatza laavir haolam. aval hecha delo yatza laavir haolam — la peligi.
Ella "efroach ukelippato" — guzema, hacha name "teachel hi veimmah" — guzema.
Ittemar, shabbat veyom tov, rav amar: nolda baze — asura baze, verabbi yochanan amar: nolda baze — mutteret baze. nema kasavar rav: kedushsha achat hi?
Vehaamar rav: halacha kearbaa zekenim veallibba derabbi eliezer, deamar: shete kedushshot hen.
Ella, hacha bahachana derabbah kamippalgi: rav it leh hachana derabba, verabbi yochanan let leh hachana derabba.

Ketannae: nolda beshabbat — teachel beyom tov, beyom tov — teachel beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: adayin hi machaloket, shebbet shammay omrim: teachel, uvet hillel omrim: lo teachel.
Ushepizkaneh derav adda bar ahava havo leh hanach betzim miyyom tov leshabbat. ata lekammeh, amar leh: may leatvoyinhu haiddana venechlinhu limchar?
Amar leh: may dataych, rav verabbi yochanan — halacha kerabbi yochanan. afillu rabbi yochanan la ka share ella legomah lemachar, aval beyomeh la.
Vehatanya: achat betza shennolda beshabbat veachat betza shennolda beyom tov — en metaltelin otah, lo lechassot bah et hakkeli, velo lismoch bah kare hammitta.

Ushepizkaneh derav pappa, veamri la, hahu gavra daata lekammeh derav pappa. havo leh hanach betzim mishshabbat leyom tov. ata lekammeh, amar leh: mahu lemechlinhu limchar? amar leh: zil haiddana uta limchar, derav la moke amora illaveh miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut.
Ki ata limchar, amar leh:
b: Echu hasheta, ishtelay vaamari lecha: rav verabbi yochanan — halacha kerabbi yochanan. ha amar rava: hilcheta kevateh derav behane telat, ben lekulla ben lechumera.

Amar rabbi yochanan: etzim shennashru min haddekel beshabbat — asur lehassikan beyom tov. veal teshiveni betza, may tama? betza mishshum divyoma name chazya legomah vela ka share la ad limchar — midda yedia devat yoma asruha. etzim dela chazu leyomayyhu, i share lehu limchar — ate lememar: beyomayyhu name sheru, veetmol mishshum shabbat hu dela chazu lehassaka.

Amar rav matna: etzim shennashru min haddekel letoch hattannur beyom tov — marbe alehem etzim muchanim, umassikan: veha ka mehappech beissura! kevan derubba dehettera ninhu, ki ka mehappech — behettera ka mehappech.
Veha ka mevattel issura lechattechilla, utenan: en mevattelin asur lechattechilla! hane mille bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan mevattelin.
Ulerav ashe deamar: kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afillu bidrabbanan lo batel, may ikka lememar? hane mille hecha deiteh leissura beeneh, hacha — mikla kali issura.
Ittemar: shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot, rav amar: nolda baze — mutteret baze, verav assi amar: nolda baze — asura baze.
Lema ka savar rav assi kedushsha achat hi? veha rav assi mavdel miyyoma tava lechavreh!
Rav assi sappoke mesappeka leh, veaved hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera.
Amar rabbi zera: kevateh derav assi mistabbera, dehaiddana yadinan bikvia deyarcha, veka avdinan tere yome.
Amar abbaye: kevateh derav mistabbera, ditnan: barishona, hayu massiin massuot. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim, hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchin yotzin.
Veillu batlu kutim — avdinan chad yoma, vehecha dematu sheluchin — avdinan chad yoma.
Vehasheta deyadinan bikvia deyarcha, may tama avdinan tere yome? mishshum dishlachu mittam: hizzaharu beminhag avotechem bidechem, zimnin degazru hammalchut gezera veate leikkalkule.

Ittemar, shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: nolda baze — asura baze, ditnan: barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom (kullo). paam achat nishtahu haedim lavo,

a: Venitkalkelu haleviyyim bashshir. hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelim et haedim ella ad hammincha.
Veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala, nohagin oto hayyom kodesh, ulemachar kodesh.
Amar rabba: mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach, betza — mutteret. ditnan: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom.
Amar leh abbaye, veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: betza asura! amar leh: amena lach ana rabban yochanan ben zakkay, veat amrat li rav ushemuel?!
Ulerav ushemuel kashya matnitin! la kashya: ha lan, veha lehu.
Verav yosef amar: af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach — betza asura. may tama: have davar shebbeminyan, vechol davar shebbeminyan — tzarich minyan acher lehattiro.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la, dichtiv: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem", veomer: "bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar".
(Vetanya:) kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom echad lechol tzad. vezo hi techumah: (elat) min (hatztzafon), veakrabbat min (haddarom), lod min hammaarav, veyarden min hammizrach.
Veamar ulla, veittema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ma taam — kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot.
Vetanya: kerem revai haya lo lerabbi eliezer bemizrach lod betzad kefar tavi,
b: Uvikkesh lehafekiro laaniyyim. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kevar nimnu alecha chaverecha vehittiruhu. man chaverecha — rabban yochanan ben zakkay.
Tama denimnu. ha la nimnu — lo.

May "veomer"? hachi kaamar, mikkede ketiv "heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim al tiggeshu el ishsha", "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem" lema li? shema minna kol davar shebbeminyan — tzarich minyan acher lehattiro.
Vechi tema: lemitzvat ona hu daata. ta shema: "bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar".
Mikkede ketiv: "gam hatztzon vehabbakar al yiru el mul hahar hahu", "bimshoch hayovel" lema li? shema minna: davar shebbeminyan — tzarich minyan acher lehattiro.
Vechi tema hane mille bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan la — ta shema kerem revai, veha kerem revai derabbanan, vekaamri leh: kevar nimnu alecha chaverecha vehittiruhu.
Vechi tema: betza name, immeno ala rabban yochanan ben zakkay vesharyuha. ki immeno — aedut, abbetza la immeno.
Amar leh abbaye: attu betza beminyan mi havay? betza beedut talya milleta. ittesar edut — ittesar betza, ishteray edut — ishteray betza.

Rav adda verav shalman, tarvayyhu mibbe chelochit, amri: af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza asura. may tama — mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo achalnu betza beyom tov sheni? hasheta name nechol. vela yadi deeshtakad shete kedushshot hen, vehasheta kedushsha achat hi.
I hachi, edut name lo nekabbel, may tama — mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo kibbalnu edut hachodesh kol hayyom kullo, hasheta name nekabbel!
Hachi hasheta! hatam edut mesura levet din. betza lakkol mesura.
Rava amar: af mittakkanat rabban yochanan ben zakkay veelach betza asura. mi lo mode rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheim bau edim min hammincha ulemala, shennohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh?
Veamar rava: hilcheta kevateh derav behane telat, ben lekulla ben lechumera.

a: Amar rava: met beyom tov rishon — yitasseku bo amamim. met beyom tov sheni — yitasseku bo yisrael, vaafillu bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. ma sheen ken bevetza.
Nehardae amri: af bevetza. dema dataych, dilma meabberi leh leelul, ha amar rav chinnana bar kahana amar rav: mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar.
Amar mar zutera: la amaran, ella deishtahi. aval la ishtahi — mashhinan leh.
Rav ashe amar: af al gav dela ishtahi, name la mashhinan leh. may tama, yom tov sheni legabbe met — kechol shavveyu rabbanan, afillu lemegaz leh gelima, ulemegaz leh asa.
Amar ravina: vehaiddana deikka chabbare — chayyshinan.
Ravina hava yatev kammeh derav (assi) bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, chazyeh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atziv mar? amar leh: dela otivi eruve tavshilin.
Amar leh: velotev mar haiddana? mi la amar rava: manniach adam eruve tavshilin miyyom tov lachavero, umatne!
Amar leh: emar deamar rava bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot. bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana mi amar?
Veha amri nehardae: af betza mutteret. amar leh rav mardochay: beferush amar li mar dela savar leha dinhardae.

Ittemar: efroach shennolad beyom tov, rav amar: asur. ushemuel, veittema rabbi yochanan amar: muttar. rav amar: asur — muketze hu. ushemuel, veittema rabbi yochanan amar: muttar — hoil umattir atzmo bishchita.
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: vechi ma ben ze leegel shennolad beyom tov? amar lehu: hoil umuchan aggav immo bishchita.
Uma ben ze leegel shennolad min hatterefa! shetek rav.
Amar rabba veittema rav yosef: may tama shetek rav? lema lehu: hoil umuchan aggav immo lichlavim!
Amar leh abbaye:
b: Hasheta muchan leadam la have muchan lichlavim, ditnan: mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat — asura, lefi sheenah min hammuchan; muchan lichlavim have muchan leadam?!
Amar leh: in, muchan leadam — la have muchan lichlavim, demay dachaze leh leinish la shade leh lichlavim. muchan lichlavim — have muchan leadam, dedateh deinish akkol midde dachaze leh.
Tanya kevateh derav, tanya kevateh dishmuel veittema rabbi yochanan.
Tanya kevateh derav: egel shennolad beyom tov — muttar, efroach shennolad beyom tov — asur, uma hefresh ben ze laze? ze muchan aggav immo bishchita, veze eno muchan aggav immo.
Tanya kevateh dishmuel veittema rabbi yochanan: egel shennolad beyom tov — muttar, veefroach shennolad beyom tov — muttar, may tama: ze muchan aggav immo, veze mattir atzmo bishchita.
Tanu rabbanan: efroach shennolad beyom tov — asur. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: af bachol asur, lefi shello nitpattechu enav.
Keman azla ha detanya: "lechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz", lerabbot efrochim shello nitpattechu enehem. keman — kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.

Amar rav huna amar rav: betza, im yetziatah nigmera. may "im yetziatah nigmera"? illema, im yetziatah nigmera umutteret leochla bechalav — ha bime immah asura leochla bechalav? vehatanya: hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot — muttarot leachlan bechalav!
Ella: im yetziatah nigmera — umutteret leochlah beyom tov. ha bime immah asura leochla beyom tov? veha tanya: hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot — muttarot leachlan beyom tov!

Vechi tema: ka mashma lan bevarayyta may dela ashmeinan bematnitin, ha name tenena: betza shennolda beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: teachel, uvet hillel omrim: lo teachel. vead kan la peligi bet shammay uvet hillel ella benolda, aval bime imman — divre hakkol sharyayn.

Vechi tema bet hillel afillu bime imman name asri, vehay dekatane "nolda" — lehodiacha kochan devet shammay daafillu nolda name sharu, ella ha detanya: hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot — muttarot leachlan beyom tov, manni? la bet shammay vela bet hillel!
Ella: im yetziatah, nigmera — umegaddelet efrochim, bime immah — enah megaddelet efrochim. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar. ki hahu daamar lehu: bee

a: Defachaya leman? yehavu leh bee dishchuta. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: mikkach taut hu, vehadar.
Peshita! mahu detema: hay laachila ka bae lehu, vehay dekaamar defachaya — mishshum ditzrivan, lemay nafka minna — lemitteva leh bene bene, ka mashma lan.
Hahu daamar lehu: bee dedichra leman! bee dedichra leman! yehavu leh bee desafna meara. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: mikkach taut hu, vahadar.
Peshita! mahu detema: hay laachila ka bae lehu, vehay dekaamar dedichra — mishshum deshamminan tefe, lemay nafka minna — lemitteva leh bene bene, ka mashma lan.
Vei baet ema: may im yetziatah nigmera — im yetziat rubbah nigmera, vechidrabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: betza sheyyatza rubbah meerev yom tov vechazra — mutteret leochla beyom tov.
Veikka deamar: may im yetziatah nigmera — im yetziat kullah nigmera. im yetziat kullah — in, aval rubbah — la. uleappoke midderabbi yochanan.
Gufa: hashshochet et hattarnegolet umatza bah betzim gemurot — muttarot leachlan bechalav. rabbi yaakov omer: im hayu meorot begidin — asurot.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: haochel minnivlat of tahor, min hashshelal shel betzim, min haatzamot, umin haggidin, umin habbasar shennitlash min hachay — tahor.
Min haeshkol shel betzim, min hakkurekvan uvene meayin, o shehimcha et hachelev ugemao — tame.
Man tanna min hashshelal shel betzim tahor? amar rav yosef: dela kerabbi yaakov. dei kerabbi yaakov, haamar: im hayu meorot begidin — asurot!
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yaakov hatam ella leinyan issura, aval leinyan tumea — la.
Vechi tema leinyan tumea name nigzor — apposhe tumea hu, veapposhe tumea midderabbanan la mappeshinan.

Veikka deamri: man tanna min haeshkol shel betzim tame? amar rav yosef: rabbi yaakov hi, deamar: im hayu meorot begidin asurot. amar leh abbaye: mimmay deeshkol, mehanach detalya beeshkol? dilma eshkol gufeh.

Vechi tema: eshkol gufeh may lememra! midde dehave akkurekvan uvene meayin, deaf al gav devasar ninhu, kevan deikka inashe dela achli — itzterich leashmoinan, hacha name: kevan deikka inashe dela achli — itzterich leashmoinan.

Tanu rabbanan: kol shettashmisho bayyom — nolad bayyom. kol shettashmisho ballayla — nolad ballayla. kol shettashmisho ben bayyom uven ballayla — nolad ben bayyom uven ballayla. kol shettashmisho bayyom nolad bayyom — zo tarnegolet. kol shettashmisho ballayla nolad ballayla — zo atallef. kol shettashmisho ben bayyom uven ballayla — adam vechol dedame leh.

Amar mar: kol shettashmisho bayyom nolad bayyom — zo tarnegolet. lemay nafka minna? lechidrav mari bereh derav kahana. deamar rav mari bereh derav kahana: badak bekinna shel tarnegolin meerev yom tov velo matza bah betza, ulemachar hishkim umatza vah betza — mutteret.
Vahalo badak! emar lo badak yafe yafe. vaafillu badak yafe, emar: yatzta rubbah vechazra havay, vechidrabbi yochanan.
Ini? veha amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rav: badak bekinna shel tarnegolet meerev yom tov velo matza bah betza, ulemachar hishkim umatza vah betza — asura! hatam bidsafna meara.
I hachi derav mari name ema meara safna? bidikka zachar bahada. bidikka zachar name, ema meara safna! amar ravina, gemiri: kol hecha deikka zachar — la safna meara.
Vead kamma? amar rav gammada mishshemeh derav: kol hecha
b: Deshama kaleh bimama.
Avad rav mari ovada ad shittin batte.
Vei ikka nahara — la avra. vei ikka mabbara — avra. vei ikka mitzra — la avra. hava ovada, veavra ammitzra.
Bemay okemta — bidsafna meara, may irya badak? ki la badak name!
Ki la badak, ema meetmol havay. i hachi ki badak name, ema: yatzta rubbah vechazra hi, vechidrabbi yochanan! derabbi yochanan la shechiach.
Veamar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rav: hay tuma shechika, sakkanta legilluya.
Bet shammay omrim: seor bechazzayit.

May tamayyhu devet shammay? im ken, lichtov rachamana chametz, vela bae seor, vaana amena: uma chametz sheen chimmutzo kashe — bichzayit, seor shechimmutzo kashe — lo kol shekken. seor dichtav rachamana lema li? lomar lecha: shiuro shel ze lo keshiuro shel ze.
Uvet hillel: tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana seor, hava amena: mishshum dechimmutzo kashe, aval chametz, deen chimmutzo kashe — ema la, tzericha.
Vei ketav rachamana chametz, mishshum derauy laachila. aval seor, sheen rauy laachila — ema la, tzericha.
Uvet shammay let lehu derabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: petach hakkatuv bisor vesiyyem bechametz, lomar lecha: zehu seor zehu chametz!
Leinyan achila kulle alma la feligi. ki peligi leinyan biur. bet shammay savri: la yalfinan biur meachila, uvet hillel savri: yalfinan biur meachila.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yose bar chanina: machloket leinyan biur, aval leinyan achila — divre hakkol ze veze bichzayit.

Tanya name hachi: "velo yerae lecha (seor) velo yerae lecha (chametz)". zehu machloket shebben bet shammay uvet hillel. shebbet shammay omrim: seor bichzayit vechametz bichchotevet, uvet hillel omrim: ze veze bichzayit.
Hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov vechulei.
Hashshochet, diavad in, lechattechilla la? ema sefa: uvet hillel omrim: lo yishchot. mikkelal detanna kamma savar yishchot!
Ha la kashya: lo yishchot vichasse kaamar.
Ema sefa: umodim sheim shachat, sheyyachpor baddeker vichasse. mikkelal deresha lav diavad hu!

Amar rabba, hachi kaamar: hashshochet shebba limmalech — ketzad omer lo? bet shammay omrim, omer lo: shechot, chafor vechasse. uvet hillel omrim: lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom.

Rav yosef amar, hachi kaamar: hashshochet shebba lehimmalech, ketzad omer lo? bet shammay omrim, omer lo: lech chafor, shechot vechasse, uvet hillel omrim: lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: lema mar verabba bidrabbi zera amar rav ka mippalgitu, deamar rabbi zera amar rav: hashshochet, tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala, shenneemar: "veshafach et damo vechissahu beafar". "afar" lo neemar, ella "beafar" — melammed shehashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala.
Demar it leh derabbi zera, verabba let leh derabbi zera?

Amar leh: ben ledidi ben lerabba it lan derabbi zera. vehacha beha ka mippalginan, rabba savar: i ikka afar lematta — in, i la — la. chayyshinan dilma mimmelich vela shachet. uledidi (adderabba) ha adifa, dei la sharet leh — ate leimmenoe missimchat yom tov.
Umodim sheim shachat — sheyyachpor baddakar vichasse. amar rabbi zerika amar rav yehuda: vehu sheyyesh lo dakar nautz mibbeod yom. veha ka aved ketisha! amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav:

a: Beafar tichuach.
Veha ka aved gumma! kidrabbi abba. deamar rabbi abba: hachofer gumma beshabbat, veeno tzarich ella laafarah — patur aleha.
Sheefer kira muchan hu. efer kira man dechar shemeh? amar rabba, hachi kaamar: veefer kira muchan hu.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella shehussak meerev yom tov, aval hussak beyom tov — asur. veim rauy litzlot bo betza — muttar.
Tanya name hachi: kesheamru efer kira muchan hu — lo amru ella shehussak meerev yom tov, aval hussak beyom tov — asur. veim rauy litzlot bo betza — muttar.
Hichnis afar leginnato ulechurebato — muttar lechassot bo. veamar rav yehuda: machnis adam melo kuppato afar veose bah kol tzarko.
Daresh mar zutera mishshemeh demar zutera rabba: vehu sheyyiched lo keren zavit.
Metivi: koy, en shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato — en mechassin et damo. vei ita, lechasseyeh kidrav yehuda!
Uletamaych: lechasseyeh baefer kira, o bedakar nautz! ella — delet leh, hacha name — delet leh.
I hachi may irya safek, afillu vadday name la!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya vadday dela lishchot, aval safek — ema mishshum simchat yom tov lishchot vela lechasseyeh, ka mashma lan.
b: Veha middekatane sefa: veim shechato — en mechassin et damo, mikkelal (deresha) bidit leh askinan!
Ella amar rabba: efer kira — muchan levadday veen muchan lesafek.
Lesafek may tama la — deka aved gumma, vadday name ka aved gumma! ella kidrabbi abba, hacha name kidrabbi abba!
Ella: safek may tama — dilma aved ketisha. vadday name nigzor mishshum ketisha! vadday, ki ka aved ketisha — ate ase vedache et lo taase.
Emar deamrinan ate ase vedache et lo taase kegon mila betzaraat, i name sadin betzitzit.
Dividdana deka miakar lav — ka mokem laase. hacha, beiddana deka miakar lav — la mokem ase! ha la kashya, devahade dechatesh ka mikkasse.
Sof sof, yom tov ase velo taase hu — veen ase doche et lo taase vaase!
Ella amar rava: efer kira dato levadday, veen dato lesafek.
Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: hichnis afar lechassot bo tzoa — muttar lechassot bo dam tzippor. dam tzippor — asur lechassot bo tzoa.
Neharbelae amri: afillu hichnis afar lechassot bo dam tzippor — muttar lechassot bo tzoa.
Amri bemareva: peligi ba rabbi yose bar chama verabbi zera, veamri la rava bereh derav yosef bar chama verabbi zera. chad amar: koy, hare hu ketzoa. vechad amar: koy eno ketzoa.
Tistayyaym derava hu deamar koy hare hu ketzoa, deamar rava: hichnis afar lechassot bo tzoa — muttar lechassot bo dam tzippor, dam tzippor — asur lechassot bo tzoa. tistayyaym.
Rame bereh derav yeva amar: koy hayeynu tama dela mechassenan, gezera mishshum hattarat chelbo.
I hachi, afillu bechol name! bachol amri lenakker chatzero hu tzarich.
Shachat beashpa, may ikka lememar? ba limmalech, may ikka lememar?
Ella: bechol [i name] missefeka, amri leh rabbanan: zil terach vechassi. beyom tov i missefeka — mi amri leh rabbanan zil terach vechassi?
Tane rabbi zera: lo koy bilvad amru, ella afillu shachat behema, chayya vaof venitarvu daman ze baze — asur lechassoto beyom tov.
Amar rabbi yose bar yasinia: lo shanu ella sheen yachol lechassoto bidkira achat, aval yachol lechassoto bidkira achat — muttar.
Peshita! mahu detema: nigzar dekira achat attu shete dekirot, ka mashma lan.
Amar rabba: shachat tzippor meerev yom tov, en mechassin oto beyom tov.

a: Gilgel issa meerev yom tov — mafrish mimmenna challatah beyom tov. avu dishmuel amar: afillu gilgel issa meerev yom tov — en mafrish mimmenna challatah beyom tov.
Lema peliga dishmuel addaavu (dishmuel). deamar shemuel: challat chutza laaretz, ochel veholech veachar kach mafrish!
Amar rava: mi lo mode shemuel sheim kara aleha shem sheasura lezarim?
Mishna bet shammay omrim: en molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach, aval mattehu mechallon lechallon. uvet hillel mattirin.

Gemara amar rav chanan bar amme: machloket birshut harabbim, devet shammay savri: haroe omer lehatiach gaggo hu tzarich, uvet hillel savri: shovacho mochiach alav. aval birshut hayyachid — divre hakkol muttar.

Ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin, afillu bechadre chadarim asur! tannae hi. detanya: shotchan bachamma, aval lo keneged haam. rabbi (eliezer) verabbi shimon osrin.
Ikka deamri, amar rav chanan bar amme: machloket birshut hayyachid, devet shammay it lehu derav yehuda amar rav, uvet hillel let lehu derav yehuda amar rav, aval birshut harabbim — divre hakkol asur.
Lema rav deamar kevet shammay?
Tannae hi, detanya: shotchan bachamma, aval lo keneged haam. rabbi (eliezer) verabbi shimon osrin.
b: Matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmolichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach. lo nechleku ella lehachezir, shebbet shammay omrim: en machzirin, uvet hillel omrim: af machzirin.

Amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — besullam shel shovach, aval besullam shel aliyya — divre hakkol asur. rabbi dosa omer: mattehu mechallon lechallon. acherim omrim mishshum rabbi dosa: af medaddin bo.
Bene rabbi chiyyay nefuk lekiryayta. ki ato, amar lehu avuhon: kelum maase ba leyedchem? amru lo: sullam ba leyadenu, vehittarnuhu. amar lahem: tzeu veisru ma shehittartem.
Inhu sevur: middeka amar rabbi yehuda besullam shel aliyya la peligi, mikkelal detanna kamma savar peligi. vela hi, rabbi yehuda tameh detanna kamma ka mefaresh.

Mimmay, middekatane: molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach, vei salka datach besullam shel aliyya peligi, hay "molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach", "molichin et hassullam leshovach" mibbee leh. ella lav hachi kaamar: shel shovach — in, shel aliyya — la.
Veiddach: mi katane "sullam shel shovach"? "mishshovach leshovach" katane, vaafillu lechamma shovachin.

Ikka deamri, amru lo: hittuy sullam shel aliyya ba leyadenu vehittarnuhu. amar lahem: tzeu veisru ma shehittartem. inhu sevur: may deka asar tanna kamma, ka share rabbi dosa. vela hi, may deka share tanna kamma, ka asar rabbi dosa.
Aval mattehu mechallon lechallon vechulei. alma, gabbe simchat yom tov bet shammay lechumera uvet hillel lekulla.
Ureminhi: hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: yachpor baddakar vichasse, uvet hillel omrim: lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom.
Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita. mimmay: dilma ad kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam, ella hecha deikka dakar nautz, aval hecha delekka dakar nautz — la.
Vei name: ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hacha, ella deshovacho mochiach alav, aval hatam — la.
Ella, i kashya — ha kashya: bet shammay omrim: lo yittol ella im ken nina mibbeod yom, uvet hillel omrim: omed veomer ze veze ani notel.
Alma, gabbe simchat yom tov bet shammay lechumera uvet hillel lekulla, ureminhi: hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.
Vedilma la hi: ad kan la amri bet shammay, ella hecha deikka dakar nautz

a: Aval hecha delekka dakar nautz — la. i name: ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hacha, ella kevan demuketze hu, beomed veomer ze veze ani notel saggi. aval hatam — la.

Ella, i kashya — ha kashya: bet shammay omrim: en notlin et haeli, lekatztzev alav basar, uvet hillel mattirin. alma gabbe simchat yom tov bet shammay lechumera uvet hillel lekulla, ureminhi hashshochet chayya vaof, bet shammay vechulei! amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.

Mimmay? dilma la hi: ad kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam ella hecha deikka dakar nautz, aval hecha delekka dakar nautz — la, i name: ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hacha ella, deikka torat keli alav, aval hatam la.
Ella, i kashya — ha kashya: bet shammay omrim: en notnin et haor lifne haddorsan, velo yagbihennu ella im ken yesh alav kezayit basar. uvet hillel mattirin.
Alma, gabbe simchat yom tov bet shammay lechumera uvet hillel lekulla, ureminhi: hashshochet chayya veof beyom tov vechulei, amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.

Mimmay? dilma la hi: ad kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam ella hecha deikka dakar nautz, aval hecha delekka dakar nautz — la. i name: ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hacha, ella dachaze lemizge illaveh, aval hatam la.

Ella, i kashya — ha kashya: bet shammay omrim: en mesallekin et hatterisin beyom tov, uvet hillel mattirin af lehachezir. alma, gabbe simchat yom tov bet shammay lechumera uvet hillel lekulla, ureminhi: hashshochet chayya veof beyom tov vechulei.
Bishlama bet shammay abbet shammay la kashya: hatam deikka dakar nautz, hacha lekka dakar nautz. ella bet hillel abbet hillel kashya!
Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita. (i name:) ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hacha, ella mishshum deen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim. aval hatam — la.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: lo yittol ella im ken nina mibbeod yom. uvet hillel omrim: omed veomer "ze vaze ani notel".
Gemara amar rav chanan bar amme: machloket bivricha rishona, devet shammay savri: gazrinan dilma ate leimmeloche.
Uvet hillel savri: la gazrinan. aval bivricha sheniyya — divre hakkol beomed veomer "ze vaze ani notel" saggi.
Uvet hillel — lema leh lememar "ze vaze ani notel"? lema: "mikkan ani notel lemachar"?
Vechi tema bet hillel let lehu berera, vehatnan: hammet babbayit velo petachim harebe — kullan temeim.
Niftach echad mehen, hu tame, vechullan tehorin. chishshev lehotzio beechad mehen, o bechallon sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa — matztzelet al kol happetachim kullan.
Bet shammay omrim: vehu shechishshev lehotzio ad shello yamut hammet, uvet hillel omrim: af mishsheyyamut hammet.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabba: letaher et happetachim mikkan ulehabba. vechen amar rabbi oshaya: letaher et happetachim mikkan ulehabba. mikkan ulehabba — in, lemafrea — la.
Rava amar: leolam lemafrea, vehacha hayeynu tama: dilma metaltel veshavek, metaltel veshavek, veka metaltel midde dela chaze leh.
Veha amrat — beomed veomer "ze vaze ani notel" saggi! hane mille meerev yom tov,
b: Aval beyom tov asur, dezimnin demishtachchi shemenim kechushim uchechushim shemenim, vekamtaltel midde dela chaze leh. i name zimnin demishtachchi kullehu kechushim veshavek lehu, veate leimmenoe missimchat yom tov.
Mishna zimmen shechorim umatza levanim, levanim umatza shechorim, shenayim umatza shelosha — asurim. shelosha umatza shenayim — muttarim.
Betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken — asurin, veim en sham ella hem — hare ellu muttarim.

Gemara peshita! amar rabba: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shezzimmen shechorim ulevanim, vehishkim umatza shechorim bimkom levanim ulevanim bimkom shechorim. mahu detema: hane inhu ninhu veithafoche ithafuch, ka mashma lan: hanach azadu lealma, vehane acharine ninhu.
Lema mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chanina: rov vekarov — hallech achar harov!
Kidamar abbaye — bedaf, hacha name — bedaf.
Shenayim umatza shelosha — asurin. ma nafshach: i acharine ninhu — ha acharine ninhu, vei la acharine ninhu — ha ikka chad dimarav behu.
Shelosha umatza shenayim muttarin. may tama? hane inhu ninhu, vechad minnayyhu azal lealma.
Lema matnitin rabbi hi vela rabbanan, detanya: hinniach mane umatza matayim — chullin umaaser sheni meoravin ze baze, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: hakkol chullin.
Hinniach matayim umatza mane, mane munnach umane mutal, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: hakkol chullin!
Afillu tema rabbanan, ha ittemar ala: rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: shane gozalot, hoil vaasuyin ledaddot.

Ulema li leshannoye ala shane gozalot hoil vaasuyin ledaddot? veha ittemar ala dehahi, derabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: bishne chisin machloket, aval bechis echad — divre hakkol chullin. vechad amar: bechis echad machloket, aval bishne chisin — divre hakkol mane munnach umane mutal.

Bishlama leman deamar bishne chisin machloket, hayeynu deitzterich leshannoye hacha shane gozalot hoil vaasuyin ledaddot. ella leman deamar bechis echad machloket, aval bishne chisin divre hakkol mane munnach umane mutal — hasheta lema li leshannoye ala? ha amrat bishne chisin la peligi!
Amar rav ashe: hacha begozalot mekushsharim vechisim mekushsharim askinan. gozalot — menattechi ahadade, kisin — la menattechi ahadade.
Verabbi amar lach: kisin name, zimnin

a: Demitakkal kitrayyhu.
Betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken — asurin. lema mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: rov vekarov — hallech achar harov!

Amar abbaye: bedaf. rava amar: bishne kinnin zo lemala mizzo askinan. vela mibbaya zimmen battachtona velo zimmen baelyona, umatza battachtona velo matza baelyona — daasiran, deamrinan: hanach azalu lealma, vehanach ishterabbove ishtarbuv unechut.
Ella afillu zimmen baelyona velo zimmen battachtona, uva umatza baelyona velo matza battachtona — hanach name asiri, deamrinan: hanach azalu lealma, vehanach saroche saruch useliku.
Veim en sham ella hen — hare ellu muttarin. hechi dame? illema bimforachin, ikka lememar: hanach azalu lealma, vehane acharine ninhu.

Ella bemiddaddin. i deikka ken betoch chamishshim amma — iddaddoye iddaddo, vei delekka ken betoch chamishshim amma — peshita demuttarin, deamar mar ukeva bar chama: kol hamedadde — en medadde yoter mechamishshim amma.
Leolam deikka ken betoch chamishshim amma, uchegon dekayyma bekeren zavit. mahu detema: iddaddoye iddaddo, ka mashma lan kol hecha demiddadde vahadar chaze lekinneh — middadde, vei la — la middadde.

Mishna bet shammay omrim: en notlim et haeli lekatztzev alav basar, uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim: en notnin et haor lifne haddorsan. velo yagbihennu, ella im ken yesh immo kezayit basar, uvet hillel mattirin.
Gemara tana: veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar — sheasur letaltelo.
Amar abbaye: machaloket beeli, aval betavra garme — divre hakkol muttar. peshita, eli tenan!
Mahu detema: hu haddin daafillu tavra garme name. vehay dekatane eli, lehodiacha kochan devet hillel, daafillu davar shemmelachto leesor name sharu — ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri, amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella afillu tavra garme chadti, mahu detema: mimmelech vela tavar ala — ka mashma lan.
Uvet shammay la chayyshi leimmeloche? vehatanya, bet shammay omrim: en molichin tabbach vesakkin etzel behema, velo behema etzel tabbach vesakkin. uvet hillel omrim: molichin ze etzel ze.
Bet shammay omrim: en molichin tavlin umadoch etzel medocha, velo medocha etzel tavlin umadoch. uvet hillel omrim: molichin ze etzel ze!

Hachi hasheta?! bishlama behema ate leimmeloche, deamar: nishbok hay behema kechusha, umayytena behema achariti deshammina minna. kedera name ate leimmeloche, deamar: nishbok hay kedera devaaya tavlin, umayytena achariti dela baaya tavlin. hacha may ikka lememar? mimmelech vela tavar? kevan deshachta — litvira kayyma.
Bet shammay omrim: en notnin et haor. tana: veshavin shemmolchin alav basar letzali. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella letzali, aval likdera — lo.
Peshita — letzali tenan! ha ka mashma lan daafillu letzali, keen kedera — asur.
Tanu rabbanan: en molchin et hachalavim veen mehappechin bahen. mishshum rabbi yehoshua amaru: shotchan baruach al gabbe yetedot.

Amar rav matna: halacha kerabbi yehoshua. ikka deamri, amar rav matna: en halacha kerabbi yehoshua. bishlama leman deamar halacha kerabbi yehoshua — itzterich, salka datach amena yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim, ka mashma lan halacha keyachid.
Ella leman deamar en halacha — peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim! mahu detema: mistabbar tameh derabbi yehoshua dei la sharet leh mimmena vela shachet, ka mashma lan.
Umay shena meor lifne haddorsan?
b: Hatam la mochcha milleta, mishshum dachaze lemizge aleh. hacha ate lememar: may tama sharu li rabbanan — ki hechi dela lisrach. ma li lemishtechinhu, ma li lemimlechinhu.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: moleach adam kamma chatichot basar bevat achat, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lachaticha achat. rav adda bar ahava maarim umalach garma garma.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: en mesallekin et hatterisin beyom tov, uvet hillel mattirin af lehachezir.
Gemara may terisin? amar ulla: terise chanuyot.
Veamar ulla: shelosha devarim hittiru sofan mishshum techillatan, veellu hen: or lifne haddorsan, uterise chanuyot,
Vachazarat retiyya bammikdash.
Verachava amar rabbi yehuda: af happoteach chavito, umatchil beissato al gav haregel —
Veallibba derabbi yehuda deamar yigmor.

Or lifne haddorsan, tenena! mahu detema tamayyhu devet hillel mishshum dachaze lemizge alayyhu, vaafillu meerev yom tov name — ka mashma lan hittiru sofan mishshum techillatan: deyom tov — in, deerev yom tov — la.

Terisi chanuyot name tenena [uvet hillel mattirin af lehachezir]! mahu detema tamayyhu devet hillel mishshum deen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim, vaafillu devattim name — ka mashma lan hittiru sofan mishshum techillatan: dachanuyot — in, devattim — la.

Chazarat retiyya bammikdash name tenena: machzirin retiyya bammikdash aval lo bammedina! mahu detema tama may — mishshum deen shevut bammikdash, afillu kohen delav bar avoda hu, ka mashma lan hittiru sofan mishshum techillatan: devar avoda — in, delav bar avoda — la.
Poteach et chavito name tenena: happoteach et chavito, umatchil beissato al gav haregel, rabbi yehuda omer: yigmor, vachachamim omrim: lo yigmor.
Mahu detema tumeat am haaretz baregel ketohora shavveyuha rabbanan, veaf al gav dela hitchil name, ka mashma lan hittiru sofan mishshum techillatan: hitchil — in, lo hitchil — la.
Veulla may tama la amar ha? biflugeta la ka mayyre. hanach name pelugeta ninhu! bet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna.

Matnitin dela chi hay tanna detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmesallekin et hatterisin beyom tov, lo nechleku ella lehachazir. shebbet shammay omrim: en machzirin, uvet hillel omrim: af machzirin. bamme devarim amurim — besheyyesh lahen tzir, aval en lahen tzir — divre hakkol muttar.

Vehatanya: bamme devarim amurim — besheen lahen tzir, aval yesh lahen tzir — divre hakkol asur! amar abbaye: besheyyesh lahen tzir min hatztzad — divre hakkol asur. en lahen tzir kol ikkar — divre hakkol muttar. ki peligi besheyyesh lahen tzir baemtza.

a: Mar savar: gazrinan tzir baemtza attu tzir min hatztzad, umar savar: la gazrinan.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: en motziin lo et hakkatan, velo et hallulav, velo et sefer tora lirshut harabbim, uvet hillel mattirin.
Gemara tane tanna kammeh derabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: hashshochet olat nedava beyom tov — loke.

Amar leh: daamar lach manni — bet shammay hi, deamri: la amrinan mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech — huttera name shello letzorech. dei bet hillel, ha amri: mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech — huttera name shello letzorech. hacha name, mittoch shehuttera shechita letzorech — huttera name shello letzorech.
Matkef la rabba: mimmay devet shammay uvet hillel beha peligi? dilma beeruv vehotzaa leshabbat veen eruv vehotzaa leyom tov ka mippalgi.
Mar savar: eruv hotzaa leshabbat, veeruv hotzaa leyom tov.
Umar savar: eruv hotzaa leshabbat, veen eruv hotzaa leyom tov, kedichtiv: "velo totziu massa mibbattechem beyom hashshabbat". beshabbat — in, beyom tov — la.
Matkef la rav yosef: ella meatta, lippalgu baavanim! ella middela mippalgi baavanim, shema minna,
Behotzaa shello letzorech peligi.

Veaf rabbi yochanan savar: bemittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech huttera name shello letzorech peligi. detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: hamevashshel gid hannashe bechalav beyom tov vaachalo — loke chamesh.
Loke mishshum mevashshel gid, veloke mishshum ochel gid, veloke mishshum mevashshel basar bechalav, veloke mishshum ochel basar bechalav, veloke
b: Mishshum haveara.

Amar leh: pok teni levara, haveara uvishshul enah mishna. veim timtza lomar mishna — bet shammay hi, deamri: la amrinan mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech huttera name shello letzorech. hacha name, la amrinan: mittoch shehuttera haveara letzorech, huttera name shello letzorech.
Dei bet hillel — kevan deamri mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech huttera name shello letzorech, hacha name: mittoch shehuttera haveara letzorech — huttera name shello letzorech.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: en molichin challa umattanot lakkohen beyom tov, ben shehuremu meemesh, ben shehuremu mehayyom. uvet hillel mattirin.
Amru lahem bet shammay, gezera shava: challa umattanot — mattana lakkohen, uteruma — mattana lakkohen. keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma — kach en molichin et hammattanot.
Amru lahem bet hillel: lo, im amartem bitruma — sheeno zakkay baharamatah, tomru bemattanot — shezzakkay baharamatan.

Gemara ka salka datach shehuremu mehayyom veshennishchatu mehayyom, veshehuremu meemesh veshennishchatu meemesh. manni matnitin? la rabbi yose vela rabbi yehuda, ella acherim. detanya, amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammattanot shehuremu meerev yom tov shemmolichin im hammattanot shehuremu mehayyom veshennishchatu mehayyom. lo nechleku ella leholichan bifne atzman, shebbet shammay omrim: en molichin, uvet hillel omrim: molichin.
