Vechach hayu bet shammay danin: challa umattanot — mattana lakkohen, uteruma — mattana lakkohen. keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma — kach en molichin et hammattanot. amru lahem bet hillel: lo, im amartem bitruma — sheeno zakkay baharamatah, tomru bemattanot — shezzakkay baharamatan.

Amar rabbi yose: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammattanot shemmolichin, lo nechleku ella al hatteruma, shebbet shammay omrim: en molichin, uvet hillel omrim: molichin. vechach hayu bet hillel danin: challa umattanot — mattana lakkohen, uteruma — mattana lakkohen, keshem shemmolichin et hammattanot, kach molichin et hatteruma. amru lahem bet shammay: lo, im amartem bemattanot shezzakkay baharamatan — tomru bitruma sheen zakkay baharamatah!

Acherim omrim: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hatteruma sheen molichin, lo nechleku ella al hammattanot, shebbet shammay omrim en molichin, uvet hillel omrim molichin. lema acherim hi vela rabbi yehuda?

Amar rava: mi katane shehuremu mehayyom veshennishchatu mehayyom? shehuremu katane, uleolam: shechitatan meemesh. lema rabbi yehuda hi velo acherim! afillu tema acherim, uvehanach denishchatu meemesh.
I hachi hayeynu rabbi yehuda? ikka benayyhu tefela.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. rav tovi bereh derav nechemya hava leh garba dechamra ditruma, ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: mahu leamtoye lechohen haiddana? amar leh: hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.

Ushepizchaneh derava bar rav chanan hava leh issureyayta dechardela, amar leh: mahu lefaroche umechal minnayyhu beyom tov? la hava bideh, ata lekammeh derava. amar leh: mollin melilot umefarchin kitniyyot beyom tov.
Etiveh abbaye: hammolel melilot meerev shabbat, lemachar menappeach miyyad leyad, veochel. aval lo bakkanon, velo battamchuy.
Hammolel melilot meerev yom tov, lemachar menappeach al yad al yad, veochel afillu bakkanon vaafillu battamchuy, aval lo battavla velo bannafa velo bakkevara. meerev yom tov — in, beyom tov — la!
Afillu tema beyom tov, veayyeyde ditna resha "meerev shabbat", tena sefa name "meerev yom tov".
Im ken matzinu teruma shezzakkay baharamatah, utenan: lo, im amartem bitruma sheeno zakkay baharamatah vechulei!
La kashya,

a: Ha rabbi, ha rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. detanya: hichnis shibbolin laasot mehen issa — ochel mehen aray, ufatur.
Lemollan bimlilot — rabbi mechayyev verabbi yose berabbi yehuda poter.
Ulerabbi yose berabbi yehuda name mashkachat la — kegon shehichnis shibbolin laasot mehen issa, venimlach alehen lemollan beyom tov, detavla beyomeh!
Ella: may teruma — rov teruma.
Amar abbaye: machloket beshibbolin. aval bekitniyyot — divre hakkol issureyayta tavla.

Lema mesayyay leh: mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel tevel — hare ze kotesh, umechashshev kamma zera yesh bahem, umafrish al hazzera veeno mafrish al haetz. may lav — rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: hatam la tavla hacha tavla!
La, rabbi hi. i rabbi hi, may irya tiltan, afillu shibbolin name?
Ella may, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda — lashmeinan shear mine kitniyyot, vechol shekken tiltan.
Ella tiltan itztericha leh. salka datach amena: hoil vetaam etzo ufiryo shave, lifrosh name aetzo, ka mashma lan.

Ikka deamri, amar abbaye: machloket beshibbolin, aval bekitniyyot divre hakkol issureyayta la tavla. metivi: mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel tevel hare ze kotesh, umechashshev kamma zera yesh bahen, umafrish al hazzera veeno mafrish al haetz. may lav, tevel tavul shel teruma!
La, tevel tavul shel terumat maaser.
Vechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin,
Shemo tovlo litrumat maaser.
Kotesh lema li? lema leh: ki hechi dihavu li, hachi yahevna lach! amar rava: kenasa.

Tanya name hachi: ben levi shennatnu lo shibbolin bemaasrotav — ose otan goren, anavim — ose otan yayin, zetim — ose otan shemen, umafrish alehem terumat maaser, venotnan lakkohen. shekkeshem shetteruma gedola enah nittelet
b: Ella min haggoren umin hayyekev, kach terumat maaser enah nittelet ella min haggoren umin hayyekev.
Mechashshev? ha medida bae!

Ha manni abba elazar ben gimel hi, detanya: abba elazar ben gimel omer: "venechshav lachem terumatchem" — bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser. keshem shetteruma gedola nittelet beomed uvemachshava — kach terumat maaser nittelet beomed uvemachshava.
Gufa, amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin — shemo tovlo litrumat maaser. may tama? amar rava: hoil veyatza alav shem maaser.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin — patur mitteruma gedola.
Shenneemar: "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser", maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha, velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, afillu hikdimo bichri name! amar leh: alecha amar kera: "mikkol (maserotechem) tarimu et kol terumat Adonai".
Uma raita? hay iddegan, vehay la iddegan.
Tenan hatam: hamekallef seorin, mekallef achat achat veochel. veim killef venatan letoch yado — chayyayv. amar rabbi elazar: vechen leshabbat.

Ini? veha rav mekallefa leh devethu kase kase! verabbi chiyyay mekallefa leh devethu kase kase! ella i ittemar, assefa ittemar: hammolel melilot shel chittim, menappeach al yad al yad veochel. veim nippach venatan letoch cheko — chayyayv. amar rabbi elazar: vechen leshabbat.
Matkef la rabbi abba bar memel: veresha, lemaaser in leshabbat la? umi ikka midde dilinyan shabbat la have gemar melacha, ulemaaser have gemar melacha?

Matkef la rav sheshet bereh derav idi: vela, veha gornan lemaaser, ditnan: ezehu gornan lemaaser? hakkishshuin vehaddilluin — mishsheyyefakkesu. veshello pikkesu — mishsheyyaamid arema. utenan name gabbe vetzalim — mishsheyyaamid arema. veellu gabbe shabbat — haamadat arema patur.
Ella may it lach lememar: melechet machshevet asra tora, hacha name: melechet machshevet asra tora.
Ketzad molel? abbaye mishshemeh derav yosef amar: chada achada. verav avya mishshemeh derav yosef amar: chada attarte. rava amar: kevan dimshanne — afillu chada akkullehu name.
Ketzad menappeach? amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: menappeach

a: Mikkishre etzbeotav ulemala.
Machachu ala bemareva: kevan dimshanne — afillu bechulla yeda name. ella amar rabbi elazar: menappeach beyado achat, uvechol kocho.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: tavlin niddochin bemadoch shel etz, vehammelach befach uveetz happarur. uvet hillel omrim: tavlin niddochin kedarkan bemadoch shel even, vehammelach bemadoch shel etz.
Gemara dechulle alma mihat melach baaya shinnuy. may tama? rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: kol hakkederot kullan tzerichot melach, veen kol hakkederot tzerichot tavlin.
Vechad amar: kol hattavlin mefigin taman, umelach enah mefiga tamah.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deyada may kedera bae levashshole, i name bemorika.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hanniddochin niddochin kedarkan, vaafillu melach. veha amrat melach baaya shinnuy! hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya, amar rabbi meir: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hanniddochin shenniddochin kedarkan umelach immahen,

Lo nechleku ella leduchah bifne atzmah, shebbet shammay omrim: melach befach uveetz happarur letzali, aval lo likdera. uvet hillel omrim: bechol davar. bechol davar salka datach? ella ema: lechol davar.
Amar leh rav acha bardela livreh: ki dayychat atzli atzloye veduch. rav sheshet shema kal buchena, amar: hay lav miggavvevy devetay hu.
Vedilma atzloye atzli? deshameh dahava tzelil kaleh. vedilma tavlin havo? tavlin nabboche menabbach kalayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: en osin tisni, veen kotshin bemachteshet. tarte?! hachi kaamar: ma taam en osin tisni — lefi sheen kotshin bemachteshet.
Velema: en kotshin bemachteshet! i tane en kotshin bemachteshet, hava amena: hane mille bemachteshet gedola, aval bemachteshet ketanna — ema shappir dame, ka mashma lan.
Vehatanya: en kotshin bemachteshet gedola, aval kotshin bemachteshet ketanna! amar abbaye: ki tanya name matnita — machteshet gedola tanya.
b: Rava amar, la kashya: ha lan, veha lehu.
Rav pappe ikkela leve mar shemuel. ayyti leh dayysa vela achal. vedilma bemachteshet ketanna avdu? dechazyeh dahava deyik tefe.
Vedilma meetmol avdu? dechazyeh dahava kelif tzahareh. vei baet ema: shane be mar shemuel, deikka peritzuta deavde.

Mishna habborer kitniyyot beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: borer ochel veochel. uvet hillel omrim: borer kedarko becheko bakkanon uvattamchuy, aval lo battavla velo bannafa velo bakkevara. rabban gamliel omer: af mediach veshole.
Gemara tanya, amar rabban gamliel: bamme devarim amurim — keshehaochel merubbe al happesolet, aval pesolet merubba al haochel — divre hakkol notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet.
Pesolet merubba al haochel mi ikka man deshare? la tzericha, dinfish betircha vezutar beshiura.

Rabban gamliel omer: af mediach veshole. tanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: kach haya minhagan shel bet rabban gamliel, shehayu meviin deli male adashim umetzifin alav mayim, venimtza ochel lematta ufesolet lemala.
Vehatanya ippecha? la kashya: ha beafra, ha begile.

Mishna bet shammay omrim: en meshallechin beyom tov ella manot, uvet hillel omrim: meshallechin behema chayya vaof, ben chayyin ben shechutin. meshallechin yenot shemanim uselatot vekitniyyot, aval lo tevua. verabbi shimon mattir bitvua.
Gemara tane rav yechiel: uvilvad shello yaasennu beshura. tana: en shura pechuta mishshelosha bene adam. bae rav ashe: telata gavre utelata mine may? teku.
Rabbi shimon mattir bitvua. tanya: rabbi shimon mattir bitvua, kegon: chittin laasot mehen ludiyyot, seorim litten lifne behemto, adashim laasot mehen resisin.

Mishna meshallechin kelim ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin, veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen kilayim vehen letzorech hammoed. aval lo sandal hamesummar velo minal sheeno tafur. rabbi yehuda omer: af lo minal lavan, mippene shetztzarich umman. ze hakkelal: kol shenneotin bo beyom tov — meshallechin oto.
Gemara bishlama tefurin — chazu lemalbush, sheen tefurin name — chazu lechassoye, ella kilayim lemay chazu?
Vechi tema chazu lememach tuteh, vehatanya: "lo yaale alecha", aval atta yachol lehatztzio tachtecha. aval amru chachamim: asur laasot ken, shemma tikkarech lo nima al besaro.

Vechi tema demafsek midde bene bene, vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar rabbi yose ben shaul, amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha devirushalayim: afillu eser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo vechilayim tachtehen — asur lishan alehem (mishshum shenneemar: "lo yaale alecha").
Ella, bevilon. vehaamar ulla: mippene ma amru vilon tame — mippene shehashshammash mitchammem kenegdo.

a: Ella bekashin, vechi ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hay namta gamda denaresh — sharya.

Amar rav pappa: ardalin — en bahen mishshum kilayim. amar rava: hane tzerare difshite — en bahem mishshum kilayim, devizrane — yesh bahen mishshum kilayim. rav ashe amar: echad ze veechad ze en bahen mishshum kilayim, lefi sheen derech chimmum bechach.
Aval lo sandal hamesummar. sandal hamesummar may tama la? mishshum maase shehaya.

Amar abbaye: sandal hamesummar asur lenoolo umuttar letaltelo. asur lenoolo — mishshum maase shehaya, umuttar letaltelo — middekatane: "en meshallechin", dei salka datach asur letaltelo, hasheta letaltole asur, meshallechin mibbaya?
Velo minal sheeno tafur. peshita! lo nitzrecha, deaf al gav denaket besikke.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af lo minal lavan. tanya: rabbi yehuda mattir beshachor, veoser belavan, mippene shetztzarich betzat haggir. rabbi yose oser bashshachor, mippene shetztzarich letzachtzecho.
Vela peligi. mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. beatreh demar — bisra letachat, beatreh demar — bisra leel.

Ze hakkelal kol shenneotin bo beyom tov. rav sheshet shera lehu lerabbanan leshaddore tefillin beyoma tava. amar leh abbaye: veha anan tenan, kol shenneotin bo beyom tov — meshallechin oto! hachi kaamar: kol shenneotin bo bechol — meshallechin oto beyom tov.

Amar abbaye: tefillin, hoil vaato leyadan, nema behu milleta: haya ba badderech utefillin berosho, veshaka alav chamma — manniach yado alehem ad shemmaggia leveto. haya yoshev bevet hammidrash utefillin berosho vekiddesh alav hayyom — manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia leveto.

Metiv rav huna bereh derav ika: haya ba badderech utefillin berosho vekiddesh alav hayyom — manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia levet hassamuch lachoma. haya yoshev bevet hammidrash vekiddesh alav hayyom — manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia labbayit hassamuch levet hammidrash.
La kashya: ha deminnatra, ha dela minnatra.
I dela minnatra, may irya berosho? afillu machatan beara name, deha tenan: hammotze tefillin — machnisan zug zug!
La kashya: ha — deminnatra mechamat gannave umechamat kalve. ha — deminnatra mechamat kalve vela minnatra mechamat gannave.
Mahu detema: rov listim yisrael ninhu vela mezalzeli behu, ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach betza
b: Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat — lo yevashshel battechilla miyyom tov leshabbat. aval mevashshel hu leyom tov, veim hotir — hotir lashshabbat. veose tavshil meerev yom tov, vesomech alav lashshabbat.
Bet shammay omrim: shene tavshilin, vvet hillel omrim: tavshil echad. veshavin bedag uvetza shealav, shehen shene tavshilin.
Achalo o sheavad — lo yevashshel alav battechilla. veim shiyyer mimmennu kol shehu, — somech alav lashshabbat.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho", zochrehu — meacher shebba lehashekicho.
May tama? amar rava: keday sheyyivror mana yafa lashshabbat umana yafa leyom tov.
Rav ashe amar: kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat, kal vachomer miyyom tov lechol.

Tenan: ose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat. bishlama lerav ashe deamar kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat, hayeynu demeerev yom tov — in, beyom tov — la. ella lerava, may irya meerev yom tov? afillu beyom tov name!
In hachi name, ella gezera shemma yifsha.

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "et asher tofu efu veet asher tevashshelu bashshelu", mikkan amar rabbi eliezer: en ofin ella al haafuy, veen mevashshelin ella al hamevushshal. mikkan samchu chachamim leeruve tavshilin min hattora.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer shehaya yoshev vedoresh kol hayyom kullo behilchot yom tov. yatzta kat rishona, amar: hallalu baale fittasin. kat sheniyya, amar: hallalu baale chaviyyot. kat shelishit, amar: hallalu baale chaddin.
Kat reviit, amar: hallalu baale leginin. kat chamishit, amar: hallalu baale chosot. hitchilu kat shishshit latzet, amar: hallalu baale meera.
Natan enav battalmidim, hitchilu penehem mishtannin. amar lahem: banay, lo lachem ani omer, ella lehallalu sheyyatzu, shemmannichim chayye olam veoskim bechayye shaa.
Bishat petiratan, amar lahem: "lechu ichlu mashmannim ushetu mamtakkim veshilchu manot leen nachon lo ki kadosh hayyom laadonenu veal teatzevu ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem".
Amar mar: shemmannichin chayye olam veoskin bechayye shaa — veha simchat yom tov mitzva hi! rabbi eliezer letameh, deamar: simchat yom tov reshut.
Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en lo laadam beyom tov, ella o ochel veshote, o yoshev veshone. rabbi yehoshua omer, challekehu: chetzyo laAdonai, vechetzyo lachem.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu. katuv echad omer: "atzeret laAdonai elohecha", vechatuv echad omer: "atzeret tihye lachem". ha ketzad? rabbi eliezer savar: o kullo laAdonai, o kullo lachem. verabbi yehoshua savar: challekehu, chetzyo laAdonai vechetzyo lachem.

May "leen nachon lo"? amar rav chisda: lemi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin. ikka deamri: mi shello haya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin, aval mi shehaya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin velo hinniach — poshea hu.

May "ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem"? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon: amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: banay, levu alay, vekaddeshu kedushshat hayyom, vehaaminu bi vaani porea.
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon: harotze sheyyitkayyeymu nechasav — yitta bahen eder, shenneemar: "addir bammarom Adonai".
I name adra kishmeh, kidamri inashe: may adra — dekayyma ledare dare. tanya name hachi: sade sheyyesh bah eder enah nigzelet veenah nechmeset, uferoteha mishtammerin.
Tane rav tachlifa achu deravnay chozaa:
